name: Save the Date — Mirror Reveal Edition
description: An enchanting, cinema-grade interactive Save the Date experience. Guests are welcomed by an atmospheric candlelight prelude, then invited to wipe away the living mist from an antique gilded heirloom mirror to magically reveal the sacred date, couple vows, celebration itinerary, interactive love story, and 1-click Google calendar & WhatsApp RSVP.
features: Interactive fogged mirror wiping canvas with realistic steam condensation physics
Falling Jasmine & Gulab flower petals simulation with fluid 3D tumble physics
Atmospheric candlelit intro prelude with gilded typography and cinematic ambient soundscape
Gilded date focus-pull reveal with high-precision typography and warm mirror glow pulse
Live luxury countdown timer to the sacred muhurat moment
Multi-event imperial itinerary tabs (Mehendi, Sangeet, Vivah, Royal Reception)
Sacred Vows & Parchment Love Letter with personalized wax seal
Interactive editorial portrait gallery with fullscreen lightbox preview
Guest Blessing Wall with interactive celebratory flower shower and real-time confetti bursts
1-Click Google Calendar sync, Apple iCalendar download, and WhatsApp RSVP greeting
Integrated Vanvi Moments luxury glassmorphic watermark badge with instant post-purchase removal
Complete seamless integration with the Vanvi Moments Builder Studio for live real-time customization
